changes.finding: BC Builds: fits the published criteria: non-residential space is 15.7% of area, under the 30% cap; ground must break within 12 to 18 months of the conditional land contribution letter.

5 storeys puts the building under Part 3 of the BC Building Code 2024 and the Vancouver Building By-law 2025; wood frame is standard to 6 storeys and encapsulated mass timber is permitted to 18 under the VBBL; seismic changes apply to permits from 2026-09-15.

Community Housing Fund: fit cannot be confirmed without the land tenure (lease of at least 60 years at nominal value, or ownership). Unit mix matches 30/50/20 within tolerance; Site control (letter of intent) meets the readiness bar; Construction must be able to start within 18 months of award; Program status: 2025 call (RFP #1070-2526-022) cancelled Feb 2026; program page says it will post when next seeking proposals (as of 22 Sep 2026).
32 of 88 units (36.4%) have two or more bedrooms, against a 35.0% minimum.
Eligible for consideration as 100% social housing under the policy, within the staff benchmark.
No minimum off-street parking applies citywide since June 2024; the option provides 40 vehicle and 220 bicycle spaces, which are set by the Parking By-law at the development permit stage.
FSR 2.49 exceeds the outright maximum of 1.2; it can proceed only by rezoning (CD-1 under the Interim Rezoning Policy for Social Housing), where density is negotiated.
Height 18.3 m exceeds the outright maximum of 10.7 m; it can proceed only by rezoning (CD-1 under the Interim Rezoning Policy for Social Housing), where height is negotiated.
Schedule C requires 20 trees on 2,811 m²; the option keeps 1 of 9 and plants 19, leaving 20, which meets the minimum.
